versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the clawdbot-workspace-template-review skill.
- Compares user workspace Markdown files against official Clawdbot templates.
- Identifies and lists missing sections (excluding frontmatter and bootstrap content) for each relevant file.
- Provides missing blocks verbatim with explanations and prompts to add them.
- Includes instructions for locating the official Clawdbot templates and suggested CLI commands for comparison.
